meta_title: RCL Property Maintenance | Painter & Decorator Southampton
meta_description: RCL Property Maintenance and Decorating in Southampton. Expert interior and exterior painting, decorating, and property finishing. Call 07717 650889 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Established Local Painter & Decorator — Southampton & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: From interior refreshes to full exterior redecorating, we transform your home with precision and care. Get a free quote today.
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior feature walls to full exterior redecorating, woodwork refinishing, and property preparation.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Fresh interior painting, wallpapering, and colour consultation. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality finishes that last, transforming any room in your home.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior redecorating for homes and garages. Our exterior work withstands Southampton's climate and protects your property for years to come.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Expert painting and varnishing of skirting boards, door frames, fascias, and built-in joinery. We deliver a smooth, durable finish every time.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Create impact with bold accent colours, feature walls, or tasteful two-tone finishes. We help you choose the right shade and execute the design flawlessly.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Thorough surface prep — filling cracks, sanding, and undercoating — ensures a professional finish that lasts. Poor prep ruins the best paint job; we never skip it.

services.title: Commercial Property Maintenance
services.desc: Schools, offices, and retail spaces need reliable decorating partners. We work to your schedule and deliver a consistently professional finish.

about_pullquote: We prepare properly and take pride in clean, lasting finishes. That's the difference.
about_para_1: RCL Property Maintenance and Decorating has served Southampton homeowners and businesses for over 15 years. We started because we believed the local market needed decorators who would show up on time, listen to what you actually wanted, and deliver work that lasted. That commitment hasn't changed.
about_para_2: Hundreds of Southampton properties — from Victorian terraces in Shirley to new builds in Totton — bear our work. We're known for thorough surface preparation, colour advice that suits your home, and painting that stays looking fresh. Customers return to us because we treat every job with the same care, whether it's a single room or a whole house.

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. Andy came round, listened to what we wanted, and the preparation was meticulous. Walls look immaculate and the colour is exactly right. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of the house done — woodwork, fascias, the lot. Takes real skill to get that crisp, clean finish. Three months on and it still looks perfect. Fair pricing too.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: We were nervous about choosing a colour for the feature wall, but they walked us through it and got it spot on. Quick, tidy, no mess left behind. Will use again for the hallway.
reviews.author: James P.
